questions.prompt: Which sub-topic of ASC 944 introduces Market Risk Benefits (MRBs)?
questions.explanation: MRBs are defined in ASC 944-40-30-19A — introduced by ASU 2018-12 (LDTI).

questions.prompt: Under post-LDTI DAC accounting (ASC 944-30), amortization is performed on:
questions.explanation: ASC 944-30 (post-ASU 2018-12) requires constant-level amortization of DAC; the legacy EGP method is retired.

questions.prompt: Under SSAP 2R, which money-market fund qualifies as a cash equivalent?
questions.explanation: Only SEC Rule 2a-7 Government MMFs qualify as cash equivalents under SSAP 2R; prime MMFs are excluded.

questions.prompt: Under SAP, an operating-lease ROU asset is admitted.
questions.explanation: SSAP 22R non-admits operating-lease ROU assets — they reduce statutory surplus.

questions.prompt: Schedule P discloses paid + incurred + IBNR triangles for the most recent how many accident years?
questions.explanation: Schedule P shows ten accident years of development under SSAP 55.

questions.prompt: ASU 2015-09 (ASC 944-40) introduced which P&C disclosure?
questions.explanation: ASU 2015-09 added the short-duration loss-development triangle disclosure (10 accident years).

questions.prompt: Risk-transfer test under ASC 944-20-15-41 requires:
choices: Significant insurance risk AND reasonable possibility of significant loss
questions.explanation: ASC 944-20-15-41 requires significant insurance risk AND a reasonable possibility of significant loss. The 10/10 'rule' is heuristic, not regulation.

questions.prompt: SSAP 62R imposes a 20% slow-pay provision on reinsurer recoverables 90+ days past due.
questions.explanation: SSAP 62R requires a 20% non-admission provision on a reinsurer's balance when paid losses are 90+ days past due.

questions.prompt: Under SSAP 26R, an NAIC 1 corporate bond is carried at:
questions.explanation: SSAP 26R: NAIC 1-2 bonds carry at amortized cost; lower designations stair-step toward fair value.

questions.prompt: AVR primarily absorbs:
choices: Realized + unrealized credit losses on bonds
questions.explanation: The Asset Valuation Reserve absorbs realized + unrealized credit losses on the bond and stock portfolios at statutory entities (Life).

questions.prompt: DAC is recognized under GAAP and ____ under SAP.
questions.explanation: GAAP capitalizes DAC under ASC 944-30; SAP non-admits all acquisition costs (SSAP 4 / SSAP 71).

questions.prompt: Carrier transfers all 2010-2018 WC reserves to a reinsurer for cash. There is significant risk transfer. The arrangement is a:
questions.explanation: Retrospective cession of an entire loss portfolio with significant risk transfer is the textbook LPT.

questions.prompt: Which PCAOB standard governs use of an actuarial specialist?
questions.explanation: AS 1210 governs the auditor's use of specialists, including engaged actuaries.

questions.prompt: Critical Audit Matters (CAMs) were introduced by which PCAOB standard?
questions.explanation: AS 3101 introduced CAM communication in the auditor's report (effective 2019 for large accelerated filers).

questions.prompt: SSAP 117 covers:
questions.explanation: SSAP 117 covers cryptoassets — generally non-admitted absent specific authorization.

questions.prompt: Under SSAP 119, climate-risk disclosure mirrors the TCFD framework.
questions.explanation: SSAP 119 codifies the NAIC Climate Risk Disclosure Survey, which is aligned to TCFD.

questions.prompt: Under LDTI, the LFPB discount rate is:
choices: Upper-medium-grade fixed-income yield, updated each period
questions.explanation: ASC 944-40 (post-LDTI): single-A upper-medium-grade rate updated each reporting period. Rate-driven LFPB changes flow through OCI.

questions.prompt: Goodwill admitted under SSAP 68 is capped at:
questions.explanation: SSAP 68 caps admitted goodwill at the lesser of 10% of subsidiary capital or the amortizable amount, amortized over 10 years.

questions.prompt: WC carrier records reserves at $500M, but actuarial central estimate is $560M. Recommended action?
choices: Adjust reserves up to the actuarial central estimate or document margin rationale
questions.explanation: Recorded reserves should reasonably approximate the actuarial central estimate. Document the margin and conclude on reserve adequacy under AS 2501.

questions.prompt: Statutory surplus formula equals admitted assets minus liabilities minus:
questions.explanation: Surplus = Admitted Assets − Liabilities − AVR − IMR.
